top_signals.title: What Israel’s Election Results Mean for the Middle East and Beyond
top_signals.summary:
Israeli elections on Oct. 27 produced a complex result, with neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc nor the opposition alliance, led by Gadi Eisenkot, winning enough seats in the Knesset to form a government. The opposition faces a tricky choice: attempt to form a unity government with Netanyahu, after channeling anger at the prime minister during the campaign, or partner with the Israeli-Arab parties, which performed unusually well in the election. top_signals.title: Bank of Canada Says Fiscal Policy Isn’t Stoking Inflation Yet
top_signals.summary: Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem said Prime Minister Mark Carney’s fiscal plans aren’t yet making it harder for the central bank to control inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
